summary: Criterion 5 lacks the required randomized window-width and spacing coverage. Earlier metre-tolerance and continuous-offset coverage fixes are present. Numerical checks were not run, as instructed.

checks.criterion: 1. Tests precede implementation and the initial failing run is recorded.
checks.evidence: The notes field at scripts/ralph/batches/t3-terrain/prd.json:112 contains the historical failure record, but notes cannot establish execution under the review rules. No failing run was independently observed; execution is prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: 2. The 5000 m / 90 m grid matches independently computed pixel centres, corners and centre.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:289-300 independently constructs the grid with loops; :353-373 asserts all coordinates and explicit corner/centre values. Execution remains unverified because checks are prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: 3. Inverse AEQD, exact origin handling including poles, and independent forward round trips meet the specified tolerances.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:210-235 implements rho, c, the algebraically equivalent latitude-increment evaluation, atan2 longitude and exact centre selection. Tests at test_geometry_aeqd.py:508-536 cover centres and poles; :565-605 cover the specified bodies/latitudes and independent forward reference. Assertions at :303-308 and :333-346 use raw metres without normalization. The asin rebuttal is mathematically supported, but numerical success cannot be established without prohibited execution.

checks.criterion: 4. Independent great-circle distances equal rho to 1e-9 relative for all three radii.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:264-268 implements an independent haversine distance; :711-721 compares all grid points using rtol=1e-9 and atol=0 across all bodies. Execution is prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: 5. Hypothesis covers random D29 widths, spacings and pixel centres, plus continuous offsets against high-precision references at unchanged tolerances.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:760-789 randomizes body, centre and pixel indices only; :783 always uses window_grid(WINDOW_M, GRID_M). Those constants come from config/run.yaml:21 and :24: 5000 m and 90 m. Required random widths and spacings are absent. Continuous-offset coverage has been restored at :827-831, :862-903 and :906-965, with 40-digit references and unchanged tolerances, but was not executed.

checks.criterion: 6. Terrain distances remain metre-valued spherical geometry, separate from radar and model distances.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/geometry.py:11-18 imports only standard-library modules and NumPy. Its inverse uses offsets divided by sphere radius at :210-217; its forward scales angular distance by radius at :329-331. No radar or model distance code is imported or reused.

pipeline/pyproject.toml:20-23 declares mpmath only in the dev dependency group; uv.lock:211-218 pins its artifact and checksums. Production geometry imports at geometry.py:11-18 exclude mpmath. No defect is established by adding this permitted test dependency.

checks.criterion: Changed paths remain within the story scope.
checks.evidence: Output lists only pipeline/pyproject.toml, pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/geometry.py, pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py and uv.lock. All are allowed story paths; config/run.yaml is unchanged.

findings.claim: Criterion 5(1) is not satisfied: the round-trip property never varies window width or spacing. Add the required randomized grid coverage, or obtain an explicit amendment covering that omitted domain.
findings.evidence: The strategies at :753-765 generate pixel indices for one configured grid, and :783 always constructs window_grid(WINDOW_M, GRID_M), fixed to 5000 m / 90 m by :80-83 and config/run.yaml:21,24. The other width/spacing cases at :376-396 test grid construction only. Other grids can contain zero or much smaller coordinate components than this grid's 25 m minimum, where the contracted metre tolerance is more demanding. The restored per-direction continuous-offset checks do not test those required grid round trips.
